description: This file defines an abstract class 'Keyboard' which models a software keyboard, including nested classes for rows and keys, and handles XML parsing to load keyboard layouts, key attributes, and layout configurations. It also manages keyboard states, key proximity calculations, and external resource references within an Android application.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: An abstract class representing a software keyboard layout, including nested classes for rows and keys, with methods for XML parsing, layout calculations, and state management.

classes.name: Keyboard.Row
classes.description: Represents a row in the keyboard layout, with attributes for key dimensions, gaps, and mode.

classes.name: Keyboard.Key
classes.description: Abstract class for a key in the keyboard, encapsulating key codes, labels, icons, position, size, and interaction states.

methods.name: getPrefKeyForEnabledRowMode
methods.description: Returns the resource ID for the preference key associated with a specific keyboard row mode.

methods.name: loadKeyboard
methods.description: Loads the keyboard layout from an XML resource, parsing rows and keys, and calculating dimensions.

methods.name: createRowFromXml
methods.description: Creates a Row object from XML attributes if it matches the current keyboard mode.

methods.name: createKeyFromXml
methods.description: Abstract method to create a Key object from XML attributes.

methods.name: parseKeyboardAttributes
methods.description: Parses global keyboard attributes from XML, such as default key sizes and gaps.

methods.name: skipToEndOfRow
methods.description: Skips XML parser to the end of the current row tag.

methods.name: getDimensionOrFraction
methods.description: Utility method to extract dimension or fraction values from TypedArray.
